lessons.text: For MU, when the latest pre-market print is within about 1% of the prior close, call the open flat with a range that reaches about 2% on both sides of the prior close, instead of leaning one way on the last few hours of drift.

evidence.count: 3 of 3 MU opens on days with a near-flat latest print moved about 2% (+1.9%, -2.2%, -2.0%); 2 of those 3 were misses that opened past the side the brief leaned

lessons.text: For MU, take the pre-market print you build the gap range on from 8:30 ET or later, after any 8:30 data release, and if the newest print you have is from before 8:00 ET, widen the range by about one percentage point on each side and say the print is stale.

evidence.count: 3 of 5 MU opens since 2026-11-09 landed 1.4 or more percentage points from the brief's latest print (all taken 7:01-7:28 ET), against 0 of 3 for the 8:30-9:00 E

lessons.text: For MU, label any level that sits inside or at the edge of the called gap range as an opening pivot instead of support or resistance, stop listing pre-market or overnight prints as levels, and make the first support and first resistance the nearest prior-session levels outside the called range.

evidence.count: 4 of 7 MU levels graded broke since 2026-11-09 were already passed at the open, each sitting inside or at the edge of the called range; 3 of 5 MU levels taken f

lessons.text: For both MU and the SOX, build the gap range so the latest pre-market print sits inside it, with room beyond that print in the direction pre-market has been moving, instead of letting the range end at or short of that print.

evidence.count: Fixed: 0 of 5 MU opens since 2026-11-09 went past the far edge in the direction pre-market was moving (3 opened inside, 2 opened past the opposite edge); the SO

lessons.text: List at most two MU levels on each side, the ones nearest the called open, and drop deeper items such as the 200-day average, round-number bear-case references and third or fourth resistances.

evidence.count: Fixed: 5 of 5 briefs since 2026-11-09 list exactly two MU levels per side; untested levels fell to 7 of 20, from 24 of 38 on 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06

lessons.text: During a run of down days, present every MU support as a level to watch rather than a floor, and drop labels like 'line in the sand' or 'support the price is sitting on'.

evidence.count: Fixed: all 10 MU supports since 2026-11-09 are labelled as levels to watch, with no floor language; 4 of 10 held, 2 broke and 4 were untested

lessons.text: For the SOX, include at least one level on each side close to the called open, and re-label any level the called gap would jump past instead of listing it on its old side.

evidence.count: Gone from grading: 0 of 5 cards from 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-13 grade the SOX, since the brief no longer has a SOX section
